title: GS Chief Credit Strategist on 2027 AI Financing Outlook
snippet: Amanda Lynam, Goldman Sachs Chief Credit Strategist, says hyperscalers issued debt early - starting in 2025, before their free cash flow turned negative - and that a recent surge pushed 2026 borrowing above Goldman’s forecast of $250 billion. For 2027, Goldman expects debt to finance 35% of hyperscaler capital spending, equivalent to about $440 billion. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Ed Ludlow on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: If You Want To Trade Like Anthropic, You Better Look Like Anthropic, Says Buyer
